svg.title: Creations Mod Manager — Keyboard Shortcut Keymap
svg.desc: Editable keyboard and mouse reference based on Shortcuts.txt. Tenkeyless keyboard; one function key intentionally unlabelled. All text and shapes are editable vectors.

g.text: Search by mod name or description
Update mod list from game folder
Mod files in the Data folder are not deleted.
Clear search; focus the mod list
Search by mod filename or description
Type in the search box, then press Enter to find a match.
Press Enter again to find the next match.
Search ignores case and matches any part of the text.
Press Esc to clear the search and focus the mod list.
Click a mod once to select it, then use:
Double-click anywhere on a mod line
Drag a mod up or down
Change its position in the mod order
Drop ZIP file(s) onto the mod list
